summary: Authored 카탈로그는 지정된 9개 brief 섹션과 8개 필수 역할을 검증하고 기존 image/comparison 선택 역할을 허용한다.
invariants: Recognize only the nine declared brief section names and validate their order, presence, and uniqueness.
Require cover, section, agenda, content, architecture, data, timeline, and closing without imposing role order.
Allow the existing optional image and comparison archetypes; reject duplicate or unknown role labels.
Catalogue contract validation does not establish generated-slide visual quality.
forbidden: Alter legitimate internal uppercase subheadings solely to satisfy a generic heading detector.
Delete existing optional image or comparison compositions to satisfy the required role list.
